‼️WORST EXPERIENCE‼️ January 2025⚠️

My kitten arrived dehydrated from travel stress, with difficulty defecating, and left with a diagnosis of euthanasia that wouldn't last a week. WTF…⁉️⁉️

“Dr. Miguel Ángel Sierra” is completely unreliable. 🚫❌ He could never call her by her name correctly; we corrected him more than five times.

His “blood tests” are also completely unreliable; he even mixed up the samples, and his colleague had to correct him. 👎🏻

He treated my cat terribly, even after I told him she was like that because of stress. (He already had that diagnosis.) He drew too much blood and shaved her terribly. DO NOT TRUST THIS PLACE. ⚠️

VERY BAD, TERRIBLE, AND EXPENSIVE 🚫❌

Fortunately, my cat 🐈 is now in good hands, thanks to the fact that he couldn't even give her a simple enema. We found true professionals. 🥰❤️

New tests confirmed that Dr. Miguel Muerte Sierra was WRONG ❗️❗️

In the words of one of his colleagues who recognized him:

"He loses his passion for the profession." 🐈❤️

We ran into a young man who was there to pick up his dog's death certificate, and there was NO communication among the staff. Why did they come to ask him how his dog was doing? ❓‼️❌

I've attached the evidence, and for any emergency involving misdiagnosis, go to Arca de Noé Veterinary Clinic in Coyoacán or Punto Veterinario on División del Norte.

They ARE PROFESSIONALS.
Excellent service, professional and friendly.

The first time I went, I only bought some grooming and had one of my dogs done; everything was perfect. But then I took my pit bull in because she woke up limping, and I thought it was just from a fall or a bad jump. But the doctor took an x-ray and told me my dog ​​had bone cancer and needed emergency surgery to amputate her leg. He even offered to give it to me for 10,000 pesos because my dog ​​wasn't going to live more than a year. I found it strange that he gave me that diagnosis so quickly; he even had students there with him. I was already resigned and crying for my dog, but I consulted with three other veterinarians, and they all said it wasn't cancer. The x-ray showed previous injuries, but nothing related. My dog ​​stopped limping after a few days and is back to normal. It surprises me that their desire to make easy money outweighs the ethics of a doctor who is also teaching young people.

The veterinarians provided excellent service. It was a routine checkup, but they made relevant observations and recommendations for my dog's health. Without a doubt, they offered high-quality and compassionate service.

They have excellent veterinarians, and they also perform tests on-site. For those tests they don't do, they're already connected with laboratories, so you can get everything done there without having to go to different places.

In particular, the cat experts are amazing. I don't know of a better place to take your kitten; they're truly experienced. Highly recommended!

It's the best veterinary hospital. They examine my dog ​​thoroughly, checking his body temperature, etc., and they don't try to run a million tests; on the contrary, they strive to be as minimally invasive as possible. Dr. Vicente is the best surgeon. He's operated on my dog ​​three times, and I can see that from the suturing to the surgery itself, he does an extraordinary job. He's the only person I trust with my pet. In general, they're very kind and treat my dog ​​well. After his surgeries, they've allowed me to be with him during his recovery. I highly recommend them.
It's a great place; I've taken my dog ​​there every time she's been sick, and they always treat her wonderfully. The prices are a bit high, but it's worth it.
In my experience, they have a highly trained staff who are also quite empathetic and patient.
